name: Republic P-47 Thunderbolt
summary: Huge, rugged WWII fighter powered by an R-2800 radial with a turbosupercharger; more than a dozen fly in the US.

wings: Large, elliptical-looking wing with rounded tips
engines: Huge R-2800 radial with an oval chin intake under the cowl
fuselage: Big, barrel-shaped fuselage with a deep belly
Bubble canopy on later D models or a razorback on early ones
Turbosupercharger bulge and exhaust duct under the rear
tail: Tall fin with a large rudder
Horizontal tail mounted on the fuselage

tellTales: Huge barrel-shaped fuselage with a round radial and an oval chin intake
Deep belly and a bubble canopy on a big single-engine fighter
Large, rounded wing and long gear legs

confusedWith.howToTell: The Mustang is slim with an inline nose and a belly scoop; the Thunderbolt is huge and barrel-shaped with a radial.
The Corsair has inverted gull wings; the Thunderbolt has a straight, deep-bellied fuselage.
The P-40 has an inline nose with a radiator scoop; the Thunderbolt has a radial and a chin intake.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
